Our go-to vegan restaurant in Da Nang
Feb 2024 • Couples
LOVING VEGAN RESTAURANT DA NANG
Best vegan Food, very popular, indoor/outdoor setting, Nice staff. This quickly became our go-to restaurant in Danang, for lunches and dinners. it can get busy at times but they always seem to be able to find you a place to sit. They are 100% vegan so you don't have to worry about the menu, they do good vegan coffee drinks as well, the only problem is that you will be tempted to order half the menu and may find yourself overeating. Don't worry because the portion sizes are good so about two dishes per person should be plenty. We were able to order something different every time we visited because their menu is quite large (about 5 pages). My wife liked the Bánh Xèo (Crispy Vietnamese Crêpes / Pancakes), Buddha Bowls, Pad Thai, Philly Cheesesteak (Bánh Mì Chay), Mac & Cheeze, Salads, Local Favorites like Vegan Spring rolls (Chả giò chay), and much more.

Insider tip:
Try to get there early, or visit at off-peak times.
